name: salesforce-to-client-cloud
description: Moves a Salesforce application to the client's cloud in six stages, with a review gate after each stage.

agents.name: Extraction agent
needs: Salesforce CLI login (sf org login web --alias myorg)
steps: sf project retrieve start --manifest manifest/package.xml --target-org myorg
agents.done_when: Every business object described, metadata retrieved, data exported with Salesforce IDs

agents.name: Modelling agent
agents.done_when: Blueprint validates against blueprint.schema.json with zero unresolved references

agents.name: Logic agent
agents.done_when: Each pending Apex method is translated, or reported as blocked with a reason

agents.name: Schema agent
agents.done_when: DDL generated for the object family; every column traces to a blueprint field
agents.note: Schema, Logic (rule compilation) and Security share one generator run: scripts/emit-postgres.js

agents.name: Security agent
agents.done_when: Each profile and permission set is a role; sharing enforced by row-level security
agents.note: Produced by the same emit-postgres.js run as the Schema agent

agents.name: Data load agent
needs: PGHOST, PGUSER, PGPASSWORD, PGDATABASE for the target database (skipped when not set)
agents.done_when: All rows loaded in dependency order, roll-ups recomputed, auto-numbers resynced

agents.name: Verification agent
agents.done_when: Every derived value matches the org; every rule case gives the expected outcome

agents.name: Repair agent
agents.done_when: Root cause explained and a generator patch proposed for review; never applied without approval

agents.name: CI/CD pipeline
agents.done_when: Pipeline re-runs all checks and deploys to Azure App Service; /health returns ok
agents.note: Triggered by pushing the approved changes to main
